name: jc-rs
tagline: 237 CLI output parsers to JSON, 21.6x faster than jc
description: jc-rs is a Rust reimplementation of the jc CLI-to-JSON converter. It ships 237 parsers that turn the output of common command-line tools into structured JSON, packaged as a single static binary. It claims 100 percent compatibility with the Python jc project while running roughly 21.6 times faster. For scripting and automation where parsing speed matters, jc-rs offers the same ergonomics as jc with far lower overhead.
highlights: 237 parsers converting CLI output to structured JSON
Single static binary with no runtime dependencies
100% compatible with the Python jc project
Roughly 21.6x faster than the original jc
curatorNote: jc is already a staple for turning messy CLI output into JSON; jc-rs gives the same workflow with a static binary and a 21x speedup. A drop-in upgrade for any jc-heavy pipeline.
